name: Hot Wife Story: Michelle and Richard
source:
Richard and Michelle are your normal couple: they work, they pay bills and they feel the love in their relationship disappearing day by day. Michelle wants to reignite their flame by role-playing as an escort that her husband is hiring.

[From [url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Hot_Wife_Story:_Michelle_and_Richard]Lesson of Passion Wikia[/url]]
translation:
理查德和米歇尔是一对普通夫妻：他们工作、付账单，却感觉关系中的爱一天比一天消失。米歇尔想通过角色扮演重新点燃激情，假扮一名被丈夫雇用的应召女郎。

[来源：[url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Hot_Wife_Story:_Michelle_and_Richard]Lesson of Passion Wikia[/url]]
